title: Welcome to HIDI, the Himalayan Institute for Data Intelligence
author: Dr Tej Bahadur Shahi
excerpt: A new not-for-profit institute bridging data, algorithms and applications, with explainable AI for Earth observation at its core: our vision, four research themes and how to get involved.

title: Towards a foundational GeoAI model for Nepal's Sustainable Development Goals
author: Dr Tej Bahadur Shahi
excerpt: Why models trained elsewhere fail on Nepal's terrain, and how a foundation model pre-trained on Nepal's own satellite archive could support many SDG indicators with few labels.

title: What drones can (and can't yet) do for Nepal's farms
author: Dr Tej Bahadur Shahi
excerpt: Five years of UAV and machine-learning research on crop disease, weeds and water stress: what worked, what still stands in the way, and our plans for smallholder farms.

title: Python for research: exploring Nepali emotions with the NepEMO dataset
author: Dr Tej Bahadur Shahi
excerpt: Load an open dataset of 4,462 Nepali Reddit posts, summarise five emotions and plot six years of trends in about 20 lines of Python.
